title: Rams (not 49ers) will get extra day on back end of Australia game

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams (not 49ers) will get extra day on back end of Australia game
sources.description: When 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan aired grievances at the annual NFL meetings in March about his team getting the short straw for a long trip to Australia to face the Rams — at (as Shanahan insists) the specific request of the Rams — Shanahan held out hope for a nugget of consideration when the 49ers return to the United States.
